item.title: RTT: Public selection for a fixed-term researchers, law 240/2010, art. 24: GSD 08/CEAR-03, SSD CEAR-03/A (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

Public selection process for the award of a fixed-term employment contract to carry out research, teaching, supplementary teaching, and student support activities at the Department of Civil-Industrial Engineering and Architecture (GSD 08/CEAR-03, SSD CEAR-03/A). The contract will have a duration of six years.

item.title: RTT: Public selection procedures aimed at the recruitment of no. 1 fixed-term researchers, pursuant to Article 24 of Law no. 240 of 30.12.2010, as amended by Article 14 of Law no. 79/2022 - RTT - reserved: see description for details (Univ. GENOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 12:00
Institution: Univ. GENOVA, Genova
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-11 Restauro e storia dell'architettura

Public selection procedures aimed at the recruitment of no. 1 fixed-term researchers, by means of the award of a six-year, non-renewable employment contract, pursuant to Article 24 of Law 30.12.2010, no. 240 as amended by Article 14 of Law no. 79/2022 (so-called researchers in tenure track - RTT) reserved, in accordance with Ministerial Decree 193/2026, for candidates holding RTDA contracts – fully funded under the PNRR – due to expire in 2025 or 2026
